artifacts.summary: Scopes the shift-of-finite-type task against existing tree machinery (FrameOver.extend_periodic, PlacedBiLasso, BiLasso/Agreement.lean), and resolves the choice-free requirement with compiled axiom probes: the H_F-membership chain becomes [propext, Quot.sound] once eq_or_ne is replaced by Decidable.eq_or_ne, while Nat.card, Fintype.ofFinite and Mathlib's SymbolicDynamics API each force Classical.choice.

user_decision.question: Deliverable (2) asks for an extension theorem over a finite-state regular frame over ℤ with '#print axioms showing no Classical.choice', but measurement shows those two halves are incompatible: [Finite W] yields no choice-free enumeration (Fintype.ofFinite, Finset.toList and Multiset.toList all carry Classical.choice) and the Nat.card bound carries it in the statement alone. Which statement shape should the plan commit to?
options: Carrier-as-data — restate (2) with (enum : List W), (henum : forall w, w in enum), [DecidableEq W], [DecidableRel F.step], bound enum.length; genuinely choice-free, but a different statement than the description's '[Finite W]' wording
Keep [Finite W] — deliver (2) as the existing FrameOver.extend_periodic already does, drop the choice-free requirement, and record the measured impossibility instead
Both — ship the carrier-as-data choice-free theorem and keep the [Finite W] version untouched, with each docstring naming the other
user_decision.recommended: Both — ship the carrier-as-data choice-free theorem and keep the [Finite W] version untouched, with each docstring naming the other
